entities.title: TypeScript library (@utv/core)
entities.summary: The TypeScript implementation of UTV, version 0.3.0: typed values and outcomes over the JSON-level everyday API, with the text form, validation and native interop.
entities.purpose: Holds one npm project: the library source in src/, its tests and example tests in test/, and the package files (package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json), with the README and CHANGELOG a person reads first.
boundaries: The contracts it implements (docs/library-api.md, docs/everyday-api.md, docs/text-form.md and the specification) are owned by docs/ and spec/, not here.
The shared fixtures, examples and demo zone rules are read in place from conformance/ at the repository root, never copied.
Build output (dist/) and dependencies (node_modules/) are ignored by .gitignore.
The CHANGELOG is the record of the library's versions.
